description: Spreads the channels of one polyphonic cable evenly across a stereo pair, with control over how wide the spread is and where its middle falls

params.text: Sets how wide the channels are spread, 0% putting every channel in the middle and 100% putting the first and last hard left and hard right
Shifts the middle of the spread, ±100%; a channel pushed past an end of the field is held at that end

inputs.text: The polyphonic signal to be spread; the channel count sets the layout, one channel going to the middle and two going hard to each side
Added to the spread knob, ten per cent of the width per volt
Added to the centre knob, twenty per cent of the shift per volt

outputs.text: The left side of the spread, with the square-root panning law applied and the level compensated for the channel count
The right side of the spread, with the square-root panning law applied and the level compensated for the channel count

notes: this expects a polyphonic cable. One channel in gives the same signal to both sides at equal level, not a hard pan.

inputs.1:
0 to 10V · continuous · one channel only

a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
